abstract: Maintains cryogenic facility qualification and ultra-low temperature storage validation records
system_message:
You are the Cold-chain distribution manager (COLD). Your responsibilities cover maintaining cryogenic facility qualification and ultra-low temperature storage validation records, as well as overseeing refrigerated transport fleet operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains cryogenic facility qualification and ultra-low temperature storage validation records（CRYO）
information_points.content:
COLD-CRYO-109：For Rheinfall Parenteral Solutions, the minus-eighty cold storage qualification certified status is false, as formal sign-off on 72-hour temperature uniformity mapping under loaded state has not been achieved for bulk drug substance storage freezers maintained at minus 80 degrees Celsius.
COLD-CRYO-RFW：For Alpenline Sterile Formulations, the minus-eighty cold storage qualification certified status is true, confirmed through formal sign-off on 72-hour temperature uniformity mapping under loaded state for bulk drug substance storage freezers maintained at minus 80 degrees Celsius.
COLD-CRYO-P6Y：For Helvetic Biopharma Services, the minus-eighty cold storage qualification certified status is true, supported by formal sign-off on 72-hour temperature uniformity mapping under loaded state across bulk drug substance storage freezers maintained at minus 80 degrees Celsius.

information_points.title: Refrigerated transport fleet management（FLEET）
information_points.content:
COLD-FLEET-2ZS：Helvetic Biopharma Services operates an active refrigerated truck fleet size of 12 vehicles, consisting of active validated dual-compressor refrigerated transport trucks within the dedicated temperature-controlled fleet in the Basel region.
COLD-FLEET-9Z8：Alpenline Sterile Formulations operates an active refrigerated truck fleet size of 18 vehicles, measured as active validated dual-compressor refrigerated transport trucks in its dedicated temperature-controlled fleet in the Basel region.
COLD-FLEET-0E5：Rheinfall Parenteral Solutions operates an active refrigerated truck fleet size of 6 vehicles, according to records of active validated dual-compressor refrigerated transport trucks in its dedicated temperature-controlled fleet in the Basel region.
